dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite-domain selector arithmetic and the printed three-arm candidate rows are internally consistent, but every empirical result underpinning the recorder-relative conclusion is explicitly source-reported and cannot be rebuilt. Event streams, raw result arrays, programs, recorder schema, checkpoint fingerprint, inputs, pairing manifest, and registered records are absent. Thus the paper cannot substantiate that its reported profiles measure the defined quantity or arose from the claimed protocol.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is unusually clear about what is and is not established: it distinguishes source-reported results, reused control status, non-headline probes, bootstrap stability, and uncalibrated rank-sum sensitivity. Definitions, tables, limitations, and anonymization are readable and the main text ends before references on PDF page 9. However, the audit framing creates substantial appendix detail around results that remain non-replayable, and the supplied source hashes cannot be checked because the TeX and bibliography are not included.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The strongest contribution is a narrow and responsible reporting/audit framework for separating recorder-window reachability from measured magnitudes. It is relevant as a cautionary case study, but the empirical case and its purported evidence audit lack the artifacts necessary for an independent reader to establish the underlying measurements; the result is therefore a limited methodological recommendation rather than verified new empirical knowledge.

paper_summary: This paper audits a blockwise diffusion-LM identity-lock diagnostic, defining a recorder-relative lock-time profile and finite-grid min-max period selector. It reports that source-provided L16 and L64 main-arm rows, alongside a reused L32 development control, select their configured block lengths; it explicitly limits L24/L48, rank-sum, spectral, content, calibration, and mechanism claims. The frozen package verifies the manuscript and reviewer-safe metadata, but not the empirical provenance or numerical replay.
strongest_verified_contribution: The manuscript's formal finite-domain definitions and the arithmetic consistency of the printed canvas-256 schedules and selector rows: Table 1's displayed NFE totals equal 48, and Table 3's displayed complete four-candidate rows have their unique positive separation at L=16, 32, and 64 respectively. This verifies internal consistency of reported values, not their empirical provenance.
strengths: The provenance rule is candid and consistently labels empirical quantities SR / CV rather than implying local reproduction (PDF p. 2, Section 2; p. 12, Table 9; pp. 15-16, Appendix B).

The recorder-relative identity-lock definition states finite observation and difference domains, candidate admissibility, tie handling, and a half-step-median caveat (PDF pp. 3-4, Eq. (1)-(2) and Section 2).
The paper correctly keeps the L24/L48 records as unauditable side observations, not headline argmax evidence, and identifies the L48 one-boundary limitation (PDF p. 6, Table 4; p. 8, Limitations).
The distinction between the two main arms and reused L32 development control is visible in Table 1 and repeated in Results; the paper does not call the control independent confirmation.
The package manifest hashes match the included PDF and reviewer-safe evidence files, and the paper is anonymous and within the stated nine-page main-text limit.
questions: Can the authors release a reviewer-safe, immutable supplement containing raw event streams or a privacy-preserving equivalent, exact event schema, analysis code, machine-readable selector/rank-sum/bootstrap outputs, input IDs or reproducible split construction, seed and pairing manifest, and hashes for every artifact?
What exact time-coordinate convention and inclusion rule generated Ti,r, including empty observation sets, terminal/unresolved positions, censored positions, and final-value encoding?
Can the authors provide timestamped registration/amendment records and the exact original-gate candidate lists and outputs, so that chronology and the reported 10/25 denominator can be checked?
Can all bibliography entries and their local uses receive metadata and sentence-level support verification, beyond the three checked closest-work entries in the supplied citation lock?

issues.location: PDF p. 2, Section 2 “Evidence status and paper identity”; PDF pp. 15-16, Appendix B “Reproduction boundary”; reviewer-safe repository inventory and experiment registry.
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript and inventory state that event streams, result arrays, analysis programs, machine-readable results, exact inputs, private checkpoint, registrations, and generating programs are absent; all experiments are marked source_reported_not_rerun or cannot_verify_locally. Only pre-rendered figures and printed summaries are supplied.
issues.why_it_matters: The claimed empirical case study cannot be independently rerun or even numerically recomputed. Internal consistency of printed values cannot establish that the results came from the declared recorder, model, schedule, population, or selector implementation. This is a demonstrated reproducibility failure, not merely a request for additional convenience artifacts.
issues.required_fix: Release a reviewer-safe immutable artifact bundle, or remove/narrow all empirical conclusions to a purely hypothetical/formal note. The bundle should include raw or suitably de-identified event records, exact inputs/split reconstruction, recorder/event schema, executable analysis and environment lock, machine-readable outputs for every table/figure, artifact hashes, and instructions for an end-to-end replay.
issues.verification_test: In a clean environment, run the released analysis from the frozen inputs/events and reproduce Tables 2-7 and 10-13 and Figure 2 exactly or within stated deterministic/tolerance rules; independently recompute all candidate rows and bootstrap/permutation summaries.
issues.evidence_needed: Artifact-level hashes, code, data/event records, environment specification, replay log, and regenerated machine-readable tables/figures.

issues.location: PDF p. 3, Section 2 “Identity-lock time and finite observation domain,” Eq. (1), especially lines 147-153; PDF p. 8, Limitations “Event semantics.”
issues.observed_evidence: Although Eq. (1) defines a finite recorder-relative lock time for source-analyzed nonempty pairs, the package does not specify whether step labels are global, block-local, or positional, nor rules for empty Ti,r, absent final values, censoring, terminal/unresolved positions, or the source-defined analyzed-decode set Ar.
issues.why_it_matters: These choices determine the scale and inclusion population of lock times, medians, adjacent differences, and period separation. Consequently, a replay could implement the stated equation while producing a different estimand; the central measurement is semantically underdetermined.
issues.required_fix: Publish a versioned event-schema/time-coordinate contract and deterministic preprocessing specification defining every event field, time axis, final-token rule, inclusion/exclusion rule, terminal/censoring encoding, and median convention, with executable validation tests.
issues.verification_test: Apply two independent implementations to the same supplied events and require identical per-position inclusion counts, lock times, m(r), d(r), and sep(P) for every arm.
issues.evidence_needed: Schema, annotated event examples covering edge cases, preprocessing code, and per-arm accounting before and after exclusions.

issues.location: PDF pp. 4-5, Section 2 “Selection stability” and Table 2; PDF p. 12, Table 9; PDF pp. 15-16, Appendix B; evidence/method_provenance.tsv entries A31-M3 and A31-M6.
issues.observed_evidence: The shared-index pairing manifest, replicate indicators, bootstrap nesting, complete candidate-level rank-sum vectors, rank-sum implementation, tie correction, normalization, and calibration are all absent. The text appropriately says the rank-sum is neither independent nor calibrated and restricts the paired relation, but the reported values cannot be replayed.
issues.why_it_matters: The bootstrap fraction and rank-sum readouts cannot be audited as stated. In particular, numeric shared indices do not establish semantic pairing, and the reported positivity fraction cannot be verified as the registered selection-and-stability conjunction.
issues.required_fix: Supply the pairing map, fixed seed or reproducible RNG protocol, replicate-level selected-period and positivity indicators, code implementing the criterion, complete rank-sum candidate vectors, and a predeclared interpretation limited to what the replay supports.
issues.verification_test: Regenerate 2,000 replicates from released data and show the joint, marginal, and positivity quantities separately; independently recompute rank-sum scores with documented tie handling and confirm that no calibrated-inference claim is made unless a valid calibration is added.
issues.evidence_needed: Machine-readable bootstrap and rank-sum outputs plus code and pairing/seed provenance.

issues.location: PDF p. 11, Table 8; PDF p. 12, Appendix A.5; PDF pp. 15-16, Appendix B “Reported determinism claim,” “Reported cross-environment replay,” and “Reproduction boundary.”

issues.evidence_needed: Immutable registrations, manifests, artifact digests, complete gate outputs, and replay logs.

ethics_concerns: No human-subject or deployment harm is asserted in the frozen paper. The main concern is research-integrity/reproducibility: unverified source-reported empirical results must not be presented as independently established evidence.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control, using only the frozen submission snapshot. No internet search, repository history, or external artifacts were consulted.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A complete reviewer-safe reproduction bundle that independently regenerates the main-arm/control tables and Figure 2 from hashed events, code, inputs, and environment specifications.
A precise, executable event/time semantic contract with edge-case tests and per-arm inclusion accounting.
Replayable bootstrap, selector, rank-sum, spectral, and content-analysis artifacts, with explicitly separated main arms, reused control, and L24/L48 side-observation scope.
Immutable registration, checkpoint/input/pairing provenance, complete original-gate outputs, and a complete citation audit.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Failure of released events/code to reproduce Table 3, Table 6, Figure 2, or the stated NFE and event-row accounting.
Evidence that the declared time coordinate, analyzed population, control subset, pairing, or registration chronology differs materially from the manuscript.
A released complete probe or rank-sum vector contradicting the stated restricted scope or reported ordering.
Citation metadata or source checks contradicting the paper's stated closest-work boundaries.
review_limitations: I verified hashes only for files included in the frozen snapshot; source_hashes.json names TeX and BibTeX hashes but those source files are not present, so those hashes cannot be checked.
I used text extraction for the complete 17-page PDF and did not rasterize figures because their captions and table references explicitly identify their non-rebuildable/data-derived status.
I did not consult the internet or any artifact outside the frozen submission, so citation assessment is limited to the supplied partial citation lock.
